description: Look-around regex syntax (?!) is not supported by the Rust regex DFA engine, causing Clippy/Cargo to fail compilation on Regex::new in server-rs/src/secret_redactor.rs.
remediation: Replace invalid dummy regex (?!) with [^\x5cs\x5cS] which is compatible with the Rust regex crate DFA engine and compiles successfully.

description: Multiple warnings related to field_reassign_with_default where structs are initialized with Default::default() and reassigned afterwards.
remediation: Consider initializing the structs with values directly in the initializer block instead of using Default::default() followed by reassignments.

description: Needless return statements and useless format! macros found in mission tools.
remediation: Remove unnecessary return keywords and convert useless format! macro calls to .to_string().
